controlled_vocabulary: general_cruelty | neglect_duty_of_care | abandonment | fighting | sexual_abuse | filming_distribution | killing | nuisance_dangerous_animal | consumption_ban
description: nuisance_dangerous_animal is distinct from general_cruelty - use it for provisions (like China PSAPL Art.89) that regulate dangerous/disturbing animals WITHOUT criminalizing cruelty itself. Value added 2026-09-15 (China, Shenzhen/Zhuhai wildlife-consumption bans): consumption_ban is for a provision that prohibits EATING/SELLING/PRODUCING FOR FOOD a given animal, not a killing-method offence or a general-cruelty offence - the underlying conduct being punished is consumption/commerce, and the offence exists regardless of whether the animal was ever mistreated. Does not fit killing (that value is for unlawful/cruel killing of a protected/covered animal) or general_cruelty (no cruelty language at all in these instruments).

controlled_vocabulary: all_vertebrates | vertebrates_plus_designated_invertebrates_by_regulation | vertebrates_plus_cephalopods_policy_only | domestic_and_captive_only_with_named_exclusions | protected_wildlife_species_only | captive_bred_wildlife_only | livestock_and_disease_vectors_only | companion_and_livestock_broad | vertebrates_excluding_fish | all_animals_undifferentiated | single_species_targeted | mammals_birds_reptiles_in_human_possession | vertebrates_plus_named_invertebrates_in_statute | all_animals_explicitly_enumerated | species_excluded_from_food_whitelist | laboratory_animals_only | captive_wildlife_display_exhibition
description: Closed vocabulary - do not free-text this field. Add a new controlled value (with a one-line justification in the codebook) rather than approximating with an existing one. Three values added 2026-09-15: vertebrates_excluding_fish (US PACT Act - mammal/bird/reptile/amphibian only, fish explicitly absent); all_animals_undifferentiated (Canada Criminal Code - 'animal or bird', no taxonomic or domestic-status qualifier at all); single_species_targeted (South Korea's dog-meat phase-out act - targets one named species, not animals-in-general). Fourth value added same session (Japan): mammals_birds_reptiles_in_human_possession - Japan's 'aigo doubutsu' definition explicitly excludes BOTH fish AND amphibians (narrower than vertebrates_excluding_fish) AND requires the animal be 'in human possession' (excludes feral/wild populations of the same species) - a combination of taxonomic-class and possession-status limits not captured by any existing value. Fifth value added 2026-09-15 (New Zealand): vertebrates_plus_named_invertebrates_in_statute - NZ Animal Welfare Act 1999 s.2 names specific invertebrate groups (octopus, squid, crab, lobster, crayfish) DIRECTLY in the primary statutory definition, not via a delegated regulation-making power (contrast vertebrates_plus_designated_invertebrates_by_regulation, e.g. Switzerland, where the invertebrate list is set by ordinance, not the law itself). Sixth value added 2026-09-15 (audit correction, Hong Kong): all_animals_explicitly_enumerated - for scope defined as an EXPLICIT EXHAUSTIVE LIST covering essentially all vertebrates AND invertebrates ('any mammal, bird, reptile, amphibian, fish or any other vertebrate or invertebrate'), distinct from all_animals_undifferentiated (Canada), where the statute is SILENT on taxonomic scope entirely rather than naming it broadly. HK-CAP169-P1 was previously miscoded as all_animals_undifferentiated despite its own notes explicitly stating this distinction - corrected. Seventh value added 2026-09-15 (China, Shenzhen/Zhuhai wildlife-consumption bans): species_excluded_from_food_whitelist - the statute names a POSITIVE list of animals that MAY be eaten (a livestock/poultry catalogue); everything NOT on that list is prohibited. This is the OPPOSITE construction from most animal_scope values, which describe what IS covered by a protective duty - here, exclusion from a permitted-food list is what triggers the provision. Critically, cats and dogs fall under this value by OMISSION, not by name - the statutory text never mentions 猫/狗 anywhere, contrary to widely-circulated media framing that these are explicit "cat/dog eating bans". Eighth value added same session (China, Regulations on the Administration of Laboratory Animals): laboratory_animals_only - scope is limited to animals used in a licensed research/testing context, a category no existing value captures (distinct from captive_bred_wildlife_only, which is about wildlife bred in captivity for non-research purposes like the wildlife trade). Ninth value added 2026-09-15 (China, CJJ/T 263-2017 Code for Zoo Management): captive_wildlife_display_exhibition - scope is wildlife held for public display/exhibition purposes (zoos, aquariums, wildlife parks), a functionally distinct activity from captive_bred_wildlife_only (breeding operations, e.g. China's own WPL Art.26) even where the same institution does both - confirmed as a real distinction by the standard's own internal chapter structure, which treats exhibition (Ch.3-5) and population/breeding management (Ch.7) as separate subjects.

description: Value added 2026-09-15: no_official_statistics_published records a CONFIRMED FINDING that a systematic search found no government body publishing cruelty-specific enforcement statistics for this jurisdiction - a first-class result (mirroring policy_effect_studies.design_type='no_evaluation_found'), not an unfilled gap. Pair with value=0 and a caveat explaining what was searched. AUDIT CORRECTION 2026-09-15: added search_inconclusive for the distinct case where a search found a COMPETING, unresolved claim that statistics might exist (not merely an absence of any lead) - use no_official_statistics_published only when the search found nothing suggesting publication exists at all; use search_inconclusive when a lead was found but could not be confirmed or refuted (e.g. Taiwan TW-NA-01, where a search snippet claims quarterly data exists but this could not be verified by direct fetch).
The count itself. For a rate (e.g. conviction rate, arrest rate) use value_is_rate=TRUE and express as a percentage (0-100), not a fraction.
TRUE if value is a percentage rate rather than a raw count.
Three-way split is mandatory - do not blend an NGO's self-reported prosecution count with a government statistical office's figures without this field distinguishing them.

Free text for methodological limitations specific to this statistic - e.g. a known undercount mechanism, a change in reporting-agency participation over time, or why a period is an aggregate rather than a single year.
